title: Safety Training
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office undergoes a safety training day featuring both warehouse and office safety concerns. Andy adopts a new name, Drew, which causes friction with coworkers, especially Dwight who shuns him temporarily. Michael attempts to lead dramatic safety demonstrations, including a risky rooftop jump onto a bouncy castle, to raise awareness about depression and workplace hazards. Meanwhile, Darryl shares serious warehouse safety risks, and tensions arise between office and warehouse staff. The episode ends with unresolved questions about the outcomes of Michael's stunts and Andy's new identity.
